verdict.rationale: RevenueCat exposes a documented REST API (api-v1.md) with public/secret key authentication and endpoints for purchases, entitlements, refunds, and promotional grants, plus a dedicated MCP server and AI Toolkit explicitly built so AI assistants/agents can manage the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (probe found no openapi/swagger.json) and independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven API usage.
